secrets.name: CSE_COPILOT_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret for GitHub's CSE Copilot endpoint. Only needed for the AI-answers search flow; general search works without it.

secrets.name: ELASTICSEARCH_URL
secrets.description: URL of a local Elasticsearch service. When unset, search requests are proxied to GitHub's production endpoint, so it is optional.

secrets.name: HYDRO_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret for sending analytics events to GitHub's Hydro endpoint in local development. Analytics events are skipped when unset.

secrets.name: HYDRO_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Hydro endpoint that receives local analytics events, paired with HYDRO_SECRET.
